title: Settings
name: Name
emailVerifyPending: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Your email changes once you confirm it there.
uiModeDesc: Choose how much of Tugra you see. Switch any time.
uiModeFleetDesc: Full control plane: servers, teams, deploys, monitoring.
uiModeHomeDesc: Simple launcher for your apps — the extras stay out of the way.
sessionsDesc: Sign out of every device, including this one. You'll need to sign in again.
logoutEverywhereConfirm: Sign out of all devices? Every session (including this one) will be ended and you'll need to sign in again.
passwordMin: New password must be at least 8 characters.
recoveryCodesDesc: Save these somewhere safe. Each code works once if you lose your authenticator. They won't be shown again.
sudoDesc: Confirm with your password and a current 2FA code (from your authenticator, or a recovery code).
channelsDesc: Deploy, server and SSL alerts over email, Slack, Discord and more.
apiTokensDesc: Personal access tokens for the API/CLI. Use as a Bearer token.
tokenOnce: Copy this token now — it won't be shown again.
noTokens: Create a token to use the REST API or CLI.
tokenScopesHint: Every token can read. Grant only what this token needs.
scopeReadSecretsDesc: Reveal env vars, credentials, and other secrets.
apiAccessDesc: Control token (API/CLI) access to this instance. Your browser session is never affected.
apiEnabledHint: When off, all personal access tokens are rejected — the web app keeps working.
apiAllowedIpsHint: One IP or CIDR range per line. Leave empty to allow any address. Requires a trusted reverse proxy to be accurate behind one.
updatesDesc: Track new Tugra releases and choose how they're applied.
updateAutoHint: Only patch releases are auto-applied; new minor/major versions always wait for you.
updateFailed: The update failed. Check the server logs and try again.
updateInProgress: An update is already in progress.
updateUnconfigured: Automatic updates aren't configured on this instance.
updateNotifyOnly: This is a minor/major release — review the changelog, then use your installer to upgrade.
updateNeedsIntermediate: This release can't be skipped to directly — upgrade to an intermediate version first.
